title: Ransomware stops card processing
business_impact: Merchants cannot take card payments. Each day offline costs an estimated AED 3m to 4m in lost fees and service-level penalties.
next_milestone: Immutable backups in production for the payments platform

title: Card data stolen through the web or API channel
business_impact: A breach of cardholder data brings card-scheme fines, forensic costs and a possible loss of the right to process cards.
next_milestone: Schema validation on every partner API endpoint

title: Security failure at a critical supplier
business_impact: A breach or outage at our card processor, hosting partner or identity-check provider would stop onboarding or settlement and could expose customer data.
next_milestone: Complete the six overdue critical-supplier assessments

title: Takeover of a cloud administrator account
business_impact: An attacker with administrator rights in Microsoft 365 or Azure could read, change or delete production data and switch off our defences.
next_milestone: Phishing-resistant MFA for the last three privileged accounts

title: Failed annual PCI DSS assessment
business_impact: A failed Report on Compliance would put our acquiring relationships and card-scheme registration at risk.
next_milestone: Close the four remaining gaps from the pre-assessment

title: Breach of UAE data protection obligations
business_impact: Late breach notices, weak consent records or slow replies to customers could lead to regulatory action and loss of trust.
next_milestone: Records of processing refreshed for all 14 business processes

title: Insider misuse of customer or payment data
business_impact: A staff member or contractor misusing access could cause fraud losses, regulatory reports and reputational harm.
next_milestone: Quarterly access recertification for payment operations roles

title: Payments platform cannot be recovered in time
business_impact: If recovery takes days rather than hours, we breach merchant contracts and the regulator may question our operational resilience.
next_milestone: Second-region recovery environment (awaiting budget - decision D2)

title: Business email fraud diverts a payment
business_impact: A convincing fake supplier or executive request could divert company funds. A typical single loss is AED 0.5m to 2m.
next_milestone: Call-back check on every supplier bank-detail change (live since August)

title: Confidential data leaked through public AI tools
business_impact: Staff pasting customer data or source code into public AI services could breach data protection and card-data rules.
next_milestone: Board decision on a governed AI pilot (decision D3)
